notes: A right-hand pose is the left-hand clip mirrored at draw time; it costs no generated frame (19).
One clip per pose to its family hub, played forwards to enter and backwards to leave, plus ten hub-to-hub bridges.
Hold loops ping-pong, so 12 frames cover a 2.4 s cycle with no seam; 15 asks for 3-6 s.
RAM stays bounded by the shipping LRU, which holds three clips.
